scope: Official macro facts only for Dec-18 2026 policy-rate no-change condition; no PM price/probability/decision.
frozen_rule: Rate change vs pre-meeting level (upper bound if band); emergency non-meeting change excluded. Cancellation or postponement with no decision before next scheduled meeting maps No Change; qualifying postponement before next meeting follows that meeting.

facts.detail: BanRep page: current policy 12.25%, effective Oct 1 after Sep30 +25bp. Oct30 rate meeting precedes frozen Dec18 meeting; Dec18 scheduled 08:30–13:00 (page-local timestamp; timezone omitted). Silence Dec12–18; Dec minutes listed Dec23. No October outcome yet.

4 directors voted +25bp, 2 hold, 1 initially +50bp. Majority cited above-6% inflation, rising expectations, demand above output, depreciation and El Niño/energy/fiscal risks; hold voters cited restrictive real rates, cumulative tightening and lags. Not a forward commitment.
DANE headline CPI: monthly 0.37%, YTD 5.74%, annual 6.29% (+1.11pp y/y). September “IPC sin alimentos ni regulados”: monthly 0.26%, YTD 4.92%, annual 6.03%; this is one named core measure.

facts.observation: Aug2026 preliminary; DANE bulletin dated Oct19
facts.detail: ISE original index 127.27, -0.04% y/y; seasonally/calendar-adjusted index 125.65, -0.11% y/y and -3.11% m/m vs July; original Jan–Aug +2.27% y/y. Historical listing shows Aug latest displayed 2026 period; ISE is monthly synthetic activity, not GDP.

Sep minutes report analyst end-2026 inflation expectations 6.8% and two-year 4.0%. BanRep lists July2026 Monetary Policy Report as published Aug4; numeric forecast not extracted here. Direct GET to monthly-analyst-expectations listing was HTTP200 Radware challenge; no October EME value verified. Search result surfaced June2026; challenge means not proof of latest/no later survey. Similar “Encuesta de expectativas de octubre” result is old Reportes del Emisor No.18 (Nov2000), not current.
